subject.title: fix(workboard): avoid duplicate proof entries on completion

question: Should Workboard's public proof contract treat a matching latest `unknown` record as the same proof attempt and update it in place on completion, rather than emitting a second terminal record?
rationale: This changes observable persisted/API semantics for proof ids, timestamps, and event-like append behavior; the linked issue already distinguishes the duplicate bug from the broader verification-contract decision.

options.title: Adopt in-place resolution
options.body: Confirm that a matching latest unresolved proof is the same attempt, preserve its id and timestamp, and merge after real completion proof is attached.

options.title: Keep append-only transitions
options.body: Retain a separate terminal proof record and pursue duplicate presentation or correlation through a different public contract.

options.title: Define a richer proof lifecycle first
options.body: Pause this PR until owners specify correlation and independent-verification semantics for proof consumers.

recommendation.title: Adopt in-place resolution
recommendation.body: Confirm that a matching latest unresolved proof is the same attempt, preserve its id and timestamp, and merge after real completion proof is attached.

likelyOwner.reason: The available context connects steipete to the linked Workboard report, the proposed lifecycle boundary, and the current branch, though current-main ownership history remains unverified.
